description:

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. title: Head of B2C Growth
description:
Who we are
Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak.
Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute.
About the job
You own B2C growth end to end. You bring buyers and renters to Properstar . You keep them coming back. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it.
That means multichannel acquisition and a lifecycle that runs from first visit to repeat visit. Search, paid social, email, push, app. The app comes first.
One gap matters most. People start with research: what a flat costs in Lisbon, how to rent in Spain as a foreigner. Later, they search for a home. Today we don't connect the two. You build that bridge.
2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it, with a large paid push in France, Spain, and Switzerland.
You own the budget and direct our paid media specialists. You report to the CPO.
What you'll do

• Set the growth strategy. Channels, markets, segments, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.

• Build multichannel acquisition. Test new channels, scale what works. Know your CPL, CAC, and payback by channel and market.

• Connect research to search. Turn people reading guides and asking questions into people searching listings and contacting agents.

• Make the app our first channel. Installs, adoption, retention. Move users from web to app and keep them there.

• Own the lifecycle. Activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, LTV. Find where users drop and fix it.

• Work the database. Segment, nurture, reactivate. Email, push, in-app.

• Run experiments. Landing pages, onboarding, messaging, offers. Fast cycles, clear reads.

• Direct the specialists. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.

• Work with product and nurturing. Push for what moves conversion. Track lead qualification with our nurturing lead.

• Prepare the 2028 ramp-up. Markets, channels, creative, tracking. Ready before we spend.

• Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.

• Talk to users. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

•
Growth track record. You've grown a B2C product with a large user base, across channels and markets. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. Marketplace, portal, or app experience is a strong plus.

•
Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel ads specialists won't fit.

•
App growth. You've driven installs and, more importantly, retention. You know what makes people open an app twice.

•
Database mindset. You think in cohorts and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest user is the one you already have.

•
Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.

•
Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a paid budget and answered for the return. You set up the campaign and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.

•
Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar.

•
Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test.

•
Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs.

•
Leadership. You make specialists better and faster without micromanaging them.

•
Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.

•
Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

• Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required

We specialize in healthcare finance, unclaimed property, risk management, and revenue cycle management, helping healthcare organizations streamline complex financial operations. Our mission is to simplify and optimize processes, so healthcare providers can focus on delivering excellent patient care .
Position Summary
The DRG Validator plays an integral role within Kodiak’s Revenue Integrity Optimization team, helping healthcare organizations improve coding accuracy, compliance, quality, and reimbursement. Working alongside an experienced, U.S.-based team, Validators perform comprehensive inpatient coding and clinical validation reviews across both MS-DRG and APR-DRG methodologies .
DRG validation at Kodiak goes beyond traditional inpatient coding review , incorporating broader clinical and quality considerations such as Hospital-Acquired Conditions (HACs), Patient Safety Indicators (PSIs), and Elixhauser measures . This expanded approach provides Validators exposure to a diverse and evolving range of coding, clinical quality, and revenue integrity concepts while contributing meaningful value to the healthcare organizations we serve.
This is a production-focused role with established productivity, quality, and performance expectations suited for individuals who thrive in being part of a high performing team environment. Successful team members consistently meet defined performance standards while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Kodiak is committed to creating a collaborative, supportive, and highly engaged team environment where people can do meaningful work, build their expertise, and enjoy being part of a growing business. As the DRG Validation practice continues to expand, team members have opportunities to broaden their capabilities, take on new challenges, and pursue professional growth and career advancement.
Qualifications

Required

• At least one of the following credentials is required: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC).

• Minimum 5 years of inpatient coding, CDI, DRG validation, or revenue integrity experience with minimum 3 years performing as a DRG validator.

• Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS coding systems.

• Strong understanding of MS-DRG and APR-DRG methodologies.

• Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.

• Demonstrates strong computer literacy, with the ability to efficiently navigate electronic medical record (EMR) systems, DRG grouping software, Microsoft applications, and other technology platforms required to perform coding and clinical validation reviews.

Preferred

• Certified Documentation Integrity Practitioner (CDIP) or Clinical Documentation Integrity Specialist (CDIS)

• Knowledge of payer reimbursement methodologies.

• Experience with quality indicators, PSIs, HACs, and risk-adjustment methodologies.

• Prior consulting or client-facing experience.

• Familiarity with compliant physician query practices and clinical validation reviews.

• Invest in your professional credentials - Kodiak supports continued professional development by providing access to continuing education units (CEUs) and reimbursement for eligible credential renewals.

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. Thatch is changing healthcare benefits. We give companies a way to offer every employee a health budget to choose the plan that fits their life, while giving employers predictable costs they can control. Making that possible means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC). Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris. La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work. We connect architects, engineers, contractors, and owners in one shared 2D/3D environment to help deliver complex projects on time and on budget. From airports and hospitals to data centers and large-scale infrastructure, Revizto supports industry leaders in reducing risk, improving collaboration, and delivering better project outcomes.

Built on a gaming engine, Revizto is designed to handle the scale and complexity of modern construction projects while remaining fast, reliable, and accessible across devices and environments - whether teams are in the office or on site. Key Responsibilities & Requirements

• Security Monitoring & Investigation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and incidents across cloud, endpoint, and SaaS environments, ensuring timely identification and assessment of potential threats.

• Incident Response Management: Lead and coordinate security incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and preparation of comprehensive post-incident reports.

• Threat Detection Engineering: Develop, test, and continuously refine security detection rules to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and maintain detection coverage aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities across cloud, endpoint, and identity telemetry to identify suspicious behavior, emerging threats, and potential security compromises.

• Security Log Analysis: Analyze and correlate security logs and telemetry from AWS, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, Kubernetes, endpoints, and SaaS applications to detect and investigate potential security incidents.

• Cloud Security & Vulnerability Management: Investigate cloud security findings and vulnerability alerts, collaborate with relevant system owners, and support timely remediation of identified security risks.

• Security Logging & Visibility: Maintain the health, completeness, and reliability of existing security log sources while identifying and onboarding additional sources to improve monitoring and detection coverage.

• Incident Response Documentation: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident response runbooks and escalation procedures to ensure consistent and effective handling of security events.

Requirements

• Professional Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, or security detection role.

• SIEM & EDR Technologies: Practical experience working with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, preferably Microsoft Sentinel, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon.

• Detection Engineering & Query Languages: Ability to write, analyze, optimize, and tune security detection queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar query languages.

• Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Solid understanding of common cyberattack techniques, threat behaviors, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, combined with a strong foundation in AWS and Azure cloud security principles.

• End-to-End Incident Response: Proven experience managing security incidents throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial alert investigation and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.

• Security Frameworks & Standards: Knowledge of established information security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, and SOC 2.

• English Proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience conducting proactive threat-hunting activities to identify and investigate potential security threats.

• Knowledge of Kubernetes and container security principles, including common risks and security considerations in containerized environments

title: UX Copywriter
description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is building the infrastructure that powers modern telehealth businesses.
Our platform enables healthcare companies to launch, operate, and scale digital care experiences, from patient onboarding and clinical workflows to prescriptions, payments, subscriptions, fulfillment, and ongoing care.
We're looking for a UX Copywriter to make complex healthcare and software experiences feel clear, human, and easy to navigate.
This isn't a marketing copywriting role.
You'll work directly inside the product alongside Design, Product, and Engineering, shaping how Bask communicates with users at every step of their experience.
About the Role
As a UX Copywriter at Bask, you'll own the words that help people understand what's happening, what they need to do, and what happens next.
You'll work across both sides of our platform: the businesses and healthcare teams operating on Bask, and the patients interacting with the experiences those businesses create.
That means writing everything from navigation, buttons, forms, empty states, errors, and onboarding flows to questionnaires, treatment experiences, transactional communications, and AI-powered interactions.
But this role isn't simply about making copy sound better.
You'll work with designers to solve product problems through language, challenge unnecessary complexity, identify when a UX problem can't be fixed with copy alone, and help establish the systems that allow Bask to communicate consistently at scale.
We value writers who are concise, highly collaborative, comfortable with complex products, and opinionated about clarity.
What You'll Do

• Partner closely with Product Designers from early exploration through production rather than joining the process after designs are complete..

• Write clear, concise, and useful product copy across onboarding, navigation, forms, settings, dashboards, workflows, errors, empty states, confirmations, notifications, and other product surfaces..

• Shape patient-facing experiences including account creation, intake flows, checkout, order management, subscriptions, and ongoing care..

• Write for complex operational experiences used by healthcare businesses, providers, and internal teams without exposing unnecessary technical complexity to users..

• Help users understand what is happening, what action they need to take, and what they can expect next-especially during high-friction or high-stakes moments..

• Work with designers to improve information architecture, hierarchy, naming, navigation, and interaction patterns through language..

• Identify when unclear copy is actually a symptom of a larger product or design problem and work with the team to solve the underlying issue..

• Develop terminology and naming systems for new features, concepts, statuses, actions, and workflows..

• Create and maintain content guidelines that establish consistent voice, tone, terminology, grammar, and writing patterns across Bask..

• Build reusable content patterns for common product situations such as errors, confirmations, destructive actions, permissions, empty states, and system feedback..

• Collaborate with Product Research to understand how users interpret terminology, instructions, and product concepts..

• Test and iterate on product language using research, product data, experimentation, and user feedback..

• Partner with Engineering to ensure content works across different states, edge cases, responsive layouts, and dynamic experiences..

• Help define how Bask communicates through AI-powered experiences, including prompts, generated content, explanations, recommendations, confirmations, and conversational interfaces..

• Use AI tools to accelerate exploration, iteration, audits, and content operations while maintaining strong human judgment over clarity, accuracy, context, and tone..

• Contribute to scalable content systems that allow teams to create consistent experiences without requiring a writer to manually review every

title: Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Romania
description:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Romania
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Romania. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.
You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.
What you will work on
Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.
What you bring
Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.
Useful but not essential:
Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About the role

Docket builds AI agents that become part of a B2B company's demand gen engine. Our Website Agent turns anonymous traffic into qualified conversations, Agent Qualified Leads (AQLs) and booked meetings, and we expand into ABM, inbound automation, paid ads acceleration, technical docs and product-led growth.

We're hiring a Customer Growth Strategist to join our Customer Success team. You've run demand gen yourself. Now you'll sit beside our customers' marketing leaders and help them get the most pipeline out of Docket: where it fits in their stack, which accounts and audiences to go after, which campaigns and content to build, and which agent to add next.

This is a strategic advisor role, not a campaign execution role. You'll work alongside our Customer Success Managers, who own each customer relationship day to day. You'll sit in Customer Success, not Marketing: you won't run Docket's own campaigns; you'll help our customers run theirs.

What you'll do

• Plan with customers: run demand gen discovery with marketing leaders, map their stack and funnel, and show where Docket drives the most pipeline

• Turn agent data into strategy: use what buyers ask, which accounts engage and where traffic leaks to shape positioning, content, campaigns and ABM lists

• Lead the next agent: build the plan for each customer's next agent type (ABM, inbound, paid ads, technical docs, PLG) and get it live

• Prove ROI: tie agent results to pipeline, cost per lead and return on ad spend in quarterly Value Reviews

• Drive expansion: spot growth opportunities and build the business case with the VP of Customer Success

• Feed proof to Marketing: surface the strongest results for case studies and testimonials

• Make the team better: create playbooks and templates the Customer Success team uses across every account

• Run on AI yourself: use AI tools and Docket's own agent data to build strategy, reports and playbooks fast

What success looks like in year one

• Every customer in the expansion stage has a next-agent plan, and most have a second agent live

• Every quarterly Value Review shows pipeline and ROI where we have CRM and ad data

• The accounts you support produce a set share of Docket's expansion pipeline, against a target agreed in your first 30 days

• Customer marketing leaders see you as a peer, and ask for you by name

• The team runs your playbooks without you in the room

Who you are

• 6+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, including time as a demand gen manager or director

• Hands-on with ABM, paid media, content and SEO/AEO, and marketing attribution

• You've owned a pipeline number and can explain what moved it

• Fluent in HubSpot or Salesforce, and comfortable pulling and reading your own data

• Credible in front of a CMO: you lead with insight and numbers, not features

• Curious about AI and how it changes the funnel

• Clear writer and presenter; turns data into a story and a decision

Nice to have

• Experience with conversational marketing, intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, Clay)

• Agency or consulting experience advising several companies at once

• Experience selling to or working in a startup

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. title: Senior NetSuite Systems Administrator
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE FINANCE SYSTEMS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Build the financial infrastructure from the ground up (NetSuite, Zip, Pigment, Visual Lease, Shareworks, Travel and Expense, and Treasury management).

- Stand up a lean finance org for the fastest-growing data center hyperscaler.

- Own the full stack from vendor invoice to cap table.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own NetSuite functional configuration end to end, including subsidiaries, chart of accounts, segments, multi-currency, intercompany, approval routing, and roles, so the system supports a multi-entity close at the speed the company scales.

- Build and ship NetSuite customizations, such as SuiteScript User Event, Map/Reduce, Scheduled, Suitelet, and RESTlet scripts and the integrations that feed the ledger, through source control, code review, and sandbox-to-production releases.

- Configure and run the NetSuite manufacturing and fixed asset modules, from bills of materials and work orders to capitalization, depreciation, and disposals, so build costs land on the books accurately as modular data center production scales.

- Own segregation of duties, access reviews, change management, and audit evidence so SOX and internal and external audits stay clean as transaction volume grows.

- Train and support finance users as the first point of contact for NetSuite, and document every configuration and script clearly enough that others can pick it up.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've owned NetSuite's functional setup for a multi-subsidiary company, including chart of accounts, segments, intercompany, multi-currency, and roles, and turned Accounting's close requirements into working configuration.

- You've written and shipped NetSuite SuiteScript (User Event, Map/Reduce, Scheduled, Suitelet, RESTlet) through code review and sandbox-to-production releases.

- You've implemented and run NetSuite manufacturing, including bills of materials, work orders, and costing, and tied the cost flow cleanly to the GL.

- You've run the fixed asset lifecycle in NetSuite, from construction-in-progress through capitalization, depreciation, and disposal, and caught mismatches before they reached the close.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're defining what AI-first product development looks like in practice: the UI/UX, the capabilities, the data models, and the systems underneath them. It's a wide open problem space, and you'll be one of the people deciding which problems matter most and how we solve them.

In practice, that means you'll:

- Set technical direction. Own the architecture for major parts of our product and make the calls that shape the platform for years to come - then write the code to back them up.

- Take on our hardest problems. The ambiguous, high-stakes, cross-cutting work: reliability at millions-of-tickets scale, evaluation and quality systems for AI agents, and the foundations other engineers build on.

- Define how we build with AI. Coding agents are a core part of our workflow. You'll design the tooling, guardrails, and feedback loops that make them effective across the team - and bring the judgment to know when output is ready to ship and when it isn't.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend most of your time building, and you'll lead through the quality of your thinking and your work rather than through a reporting line.

Our stack is TypeScript, React/Remix, PrismaORM, NestJS, and some Python. Knowledge of the stack is nice; we know great engineers pick things up fast.

- Have 10+ years of experience shipping software, including time as a staff- or principal-level engineer at a company with high engineering standards

- Have set the technical direction for a product or platform and lived with the consequences - you can tell us what you'd do differently

- Have led ambiguous, high-stakes projects from blank page to production, across the stack

- Make other engineers better through design reviews, mentorship, and the example you set in your own code

- Use coding agents as a core part of how you build - not just as autocomplete, but as a real development workflow - and have opinions on how teams should use them

- Want to be early: real scope, real ownership, and real upside at a fast-moving company

WHAT'S UNIQUE ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY?

A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it - because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company - not just execute someone else's vision.

description:
Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions
Office Job Description
Join Us as a ( Senior) Clinical Research Associate in our client dedicated FSP team - Netherlands. Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Senior Clinical Research Associate (Level I), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.
We are seeking a (Senior) Clinical Research Associate to join our client dedicated FSP team - The Netherlands . The position can be fully remote in Belgium or hybrid/office based from our site in Ede.
We do require previous independent monitoring CRA experience and fluency in Dutch and English.
What You’ll Do:

• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
